Supreme Court JCA Answer Key
Out · Objection Till 23 Nov
org_full: Supreme Court of India – Recruitment Cell
intro: The Supreme Court of India Recruitment Cell has released the Junior Court Assistant (JCA) Answer Key 2026 on 22 November 2026 along with candidate response sheets.
Candidates can raise objections against the provisional answer key till 23 November 2026, 11:55 PM, after which the objection portal will close.
steps: Visit the Supreme Court recruitment portal on sci.gov.in.
Log in with your application details.
View the provisional answer key and your response sheet.
Calculate your score and select any question you want to challenge.
Submit the objection with supporting proof before 23 November, 11:55 PM.
faq: When was the Supreme Court JCA answer key released?
What is the last date to raise objection?
Will a final answer key be released?
Yes, the final key and result are released after reviewing objections.
final: Check your Supreme Court JCA response sheet today and raise objections before the window closes tonight.
